verses: Taiti gogo ihut tu Ho, palungun rohanami.
Tu surgo i, ingananMi, o Jesus, Tuhannami!
Togu tongtong ma hami on di dalanMi tu surgo.
Anggo so i oloanMi sai saut do hami mago.
Alai tahe, suraon be, so oloanMu hami!
PinorsanMi do dosa i lao paluahon hami.
Dibahen i, o Jesuski sai naeng ihuthononku
Do hataMi, nang langkaMi, saleleng au mangolu
Taiti gogo ihut tu Ho, au tu banua ginjang.
Asa disi pujionki, denggan basaM, o Tuhan.

rows: O Ton-di Par-ba-di-a i, bo-ngo-ti ro-ha-na-mi be, ro, si-pa-ti-ur ro-ha!

verses: O Tondi Parbadia i, bongoti rohanami be, ro, sipatiur roha!
O sondang sian Surgo i, sondangi rohanami be, tuhalalas ni roha!
Asa masa patupahon pinodahon ni hataMu.
Sai tu hami ma rohamu!
Ho do silehon roha i di nasa na porsea i,
Tumpahi rohanami! Patogu rohanami be,
Pasar hataM tu sasude sai tong dongani hami,
On pe sude, parrohaon, hatuaon lehononMu.
Sipujion do GoarMu!
Sai pargogoi ma hami on mangihutihut hataMon
Di pardalanannami, haporseaonnami pe
Tambai tung masa aha pe na bernit taononnami.
Tatap, tatap sude hami, rohanami pasonangkon,
Hajolmaon hamonangkon!
Sungguli hami on sude huhut paburju hami be
Mangalo dosanami, papir ma tondinami on,
Papos ma rohanami on di paraloannami.
Gohi, gohi rohanami asa hami mambolongkon
Losok dohot halembaon.
Ho batu mamak na togu, na tau ojahan situtu,
Paojak rohanami tu hata hasintongan i.
Tung unang olo lilu be nang sada sian hami,
Lehon roha na tumogu, na umburju, manggoari
Jesus Kristus Tuhannami.
Pangapul sian surgo i, songgopi rohanami be,
Pasaor dameM tu hami, pamalo hami on tongtong
Mamboan roha na holong di angka dongannami.
Dao ma bada, dohot hosom, ingkon tongtong sonang hami
Mandalani dalannami.
Parbadiai ma hami on, huhut patogu ma tongtong.
Torusi rohanami, tanggali sian hami be,
Huhut pabali sasude na tau mangago hami.
Taiti hami tu na sonang na do ginjang, sumangkaphon,
Hangoluan, hasangapon.

r: Ho do si-le-hon ro-ha i di na-sa na por-se-a i, Tum-pa-hi ro-ha-na-mi!
Pa-to-gu ro-ha-na-mi be, Pa-sar ha-taM tu sa-su-de sai tong do-nga-ni ha-mi,
On pe su-de, par-ro-ha-on, ha-tu-a-on le-ho-non-Mu. Si-pu-ji-on do Go-ar-Mu!
Sai par-go-goi ma ha-mi on ma-ngi-hu-ti-hut ha-ta-Mon Di par-da-la-nan-na-mi,
ha-por-sea-on-na-mi pe Tam-bai tung ma-sa a-ha pe na ber-nit ta-o-non-na-mi.
Ta-tap, ta-tap su-de ha-mi, ro-ha-na-mi pa-so-nang-kon, Ha-jol-ma-on ha-mo-nang-kon!
Sung-gu-li ha-mi on su-de hu-hut pa-bur-ju ha-mi be Ma-nga-lo do-sa-na-mi,
pa-pir ma ton-di-na-mi on, Pa-pos ma ro-ha-na-mi on di pa-ra-lo-an-na-mi.
Go-hi, go-hi ro-ha-na-mi a-sa ha-mi mam-bo-long-kon Lo-sok do-hot ha-lem-ba-on.
Ho ba-tu ma-mak na to-gu, na tau o-ja-han si-tu-tu, Pa-o-jak ro-ha-na-mi
tu ha-ta ha-sin-to-ngan i. Tung u-nang o-lo li-lu be nang sa-da si-an ha-mi,
Le-hon ro-ha na tu-mo-gu, na um-bur-ju, mang-go-a-ri Je-sus Kris-tus Tu-han-na-mi.
Pa-nga-pul si-an sur-go i, song-go-pi ro-ha-na-mi be, Pa-saor da-meM tu ha-mi,
pa-ma-lo ha-mi on tong-tong Mam-bo-an ro-ha na ho-long di ang-ka do-ngan-na-mi.
Dao ma ba-da, do-hot ho-som, ing-kon tong-tong so-nang ha-mi Man-da-la-ni da-lan-na-mi.
Par-ba-di-ai ma ha-mi on, hu-hut pa-to-gu ma tong-tong. To-ru-si ro-ha-na-mi,
tang-ga-li si-an ha-mi be, Hu-hut pa-ba-li sa-su-de na tau ma-nga-go ha-mi.
Tai-ti ha-mi tu na so-nang na do gin-jang, su-mang-kap-hon, Ha-ngo-lu-an, ha-sa-nga-pon.

Binaen ni mudar ni Jesus, Tuhannami.
Sai paburju rohanami, roha ni sobuk i
Talu baenonnami asa unang sirang hami
Ala ni dosa i sian Tuhannami.
Molo ajalnami jumpang togu ne sasude
Tu banua ginjang! Sai tumpahi hami monang,
Sahat di surgo i saluhutna sonang,

Ai nuaeng ma jumpang ari parningotan Pentakoste i;
Haroro ni Tondi do, i ma Tondi Parbasia, masuk tu huria.
Jangkon ma Ibana, ai asi rohaNa ro tu hita on,
Asa sondangonNa, tiur bahenonNa, parrohaon tongtong.
Jangkon ma Ibana da asa lao sude arsakmu,
Nang pardangolanmu.
Tondi pangapuli, sahap na umuli di sisean ni
Tuhan Jesus Kristus ro ma Ho, pabolus
Tongtong langkangki di na lao tu surgo au,
Pargogoi ma au, pamonang, sahat tu na sonang.

Ton-di pa-nga-pu-li, sa-hap na um-u-li di si-se-an ni

Martangiang tu Tuhanta, asa tongtong oloanNa

Pargogoi ma hami be maralohon dosanami,
Asa tung malua hami sian hadosaonnami,
Jolma manisia pe sai sondangi ma luhutna.
Asa olo sasude ro tu Jesus, Sipalua.

verses: Haleluya! Pinuji ma na sasadasa Debata,
Sitompa saluhutna! Ai asi ni rohaNa i,
Gogona pe, tongamna i, ingkon endehononta,
Haleluya, pinuji ma na tuat sian Debata.
AnakNa sasadasa na mate ala dosa i,
Patupa hangoluan i, ingkon endehononta.
Haleluya, pinuji ma panondang sian Debata,
Simuru tu rohanta, pangapul na sumurung i,
Partogi, pangajari i, ingkon endehononta,
Haleluya! Di Ama i, di Anak dohot Tondi i
Pujipujiannnami. Di Ho ma hasangapon i,
Rodi hamuliaon i, dilehon rohanami.

r: Ha-le-lu-ya, pi-nu-ji ma na tu-at si-an De-ba-ta. A-nak-Na sa-sa-da-sa na ma-te a-la do-sa i, Pa-tu-pa ha-ngo-lu-an i, ing-kon en-de-ho-non-ta.
Ha-le-lu-ya, pi-nu-ji ma pa-non-dang si-an De-ba-ta, Si-mu-ru tu ro-han-ta, pa-nga-pul na su-mu-rung i, Par-to-gi, pa-nga-ja-ri i, ing-kon en-de-ho-non-ta,

Dok ma ma-u-li-a-te-i tu De-ba-ta, A-man-ta.
Ai par-da-ngo-lan i su-de, nang sa-lu-hut-na jor-but pe di-a-lo De-ba-tan-ta.

verses: Patimbul be ma sangap ni Jahowa, Debatanta
Dok ma mauliatei tu Debata, Amanta.
Ai pardangolan i sude, nang saluhutna jorbut pe
Dialo Debatanta.
Tongtong sombaonnami Ho mamuji salelengna,
Dibaen na digomgomi Ho, HuriaMu sudena.
Na so tardodo gogoMi, sai ingkon saut do rohaMi;
On pe martua hami.
O Jesus, na sasada Ho do anak ni Debata,
Naung mago dipangolu Ho, diontok Ho do bada.
O Jesus, Tuhannami on tangihon sombanami on,
Asi rohaM di hami !
O Tondi Parbadia i, ramoti ma sudena,
Naung dipalua Kristus i, marhite na tinaonna.
Ambati ma sibolis i, padao nang nasa jea i,
Papos ma rohanami !

r: Tong-tong som-ba-on-na-mi Ho ma-mu-ji sa-le-leng-na,
Di-baen na di-gom-go-mi Ho, Hu-ri-a-Mu su-de-na.
Na so tar-do-do go-go-Mi, sai ing-kon saut do ro-ha-Mi; On pe mar-tu-a ha-mi.
O Je-sus, na sa-sa-da Ho do a-nak ni De-ba-ta,
Naung ma-go di-pa-ngo-lu Ho, di-on-tok Ho do ba-da.
O Je-sus, Tu-han-na-mi on ta-ngi-hon som-ba-na-mi on, A-si ro-haM di ha-mi!
O Ton-di Par-ba-di-a i, ra-mo-ti ma su-de-na,
Naung di-pa-lu-a Kris-tus i, mar-hi-te na ti-naon-na.
Am-ba-ti ma si-bo-lis i, pa-dao nang na-sa je-a i, Pa-pos ma ro-ha-na-mi!

verses: Haleluya! Tapuji ma Amanta Tuhan Debata dibaen denggan basaNa.
Sai tong girgir ma hita be pasangap Debatanta i, dibaen asi rohaNa.
Sangap, sangap. Hagogoon, Hatoguon. hapistaran,
Di Amanta na di ginjang
Haleluya ! Di Jesus i, talehon hasangapon i
Nang pe pujipujian, dilehon do mudarNa i,
Mamuri hita sasude, parade hatigoran.
Denggan, denggan, parasoranta tu Tuhanta, badiaNa
Songgop do tu huriaNa.
Haleluya ! Di Tondi i, na sanggap, na badia i,
Tadok mauliate, aut unang saor Ibana tu
Rohanta naa so dung logu, luhutna do mandate
Tua, tua, ma jambarta bahenonNa salelengna
Di adopan ni Debata.
Haleluya ! Lam ganda ma biarta mida Debata,
Nang holong ni rohanta, i ma mandasdas hita on,
Pasangap Debata tongtong marhite parangenta
Puji, puji! Tolu hali taulahi manggandahon
Tu Ibana hasangapon.

di-le-hon do mu-dar-Na i, Ma-mu-ri hi-ta sa-su-de, pa-ra-de ha-ti-go-ran.
Deng-gan, deng-gan, pa-ra-so-ran-ta tu Tu-han-ta, ba-dia-Na Song-gop do tu hu-ri-a-Na.

u-nang saor I-ba-na tu Ro-han-ta na-a so dung lo-gu, lu-hut-na do man-da-te
Tu-a, tu-a, ma jam-bar-ta ba-he-non-Na sa-le-leng-na Di a-do-pan ni De-ba-ta.

i ma man-das-das hi-ta on, Pa-sa-ngap De-ba-ta tong-tong mar-hi-te pa-ra-ngen-ta
Pu-ji, pu-ji! To-lu ha-li ta-u-la-hi mang-gan-da-hon Tu I-ba-na ha-sa-nga-pon.

Si-an ha-ngo-lu-an i. na ra-de di sur-go i; Ai naung se-sa do do-sang-ku si-an a-si ni ro-ha-Mu.

verses: Dobata Sitolu sada, Ama, Anak, Tondi i,
Nunga montok nasa hada, na paholang sondingki
Sian hangoluan i. na rade di surgo i;
Ai naung sesa do dosangku sian asi ni rohaMu.
Sai ingani ma rohangku, sai parbadiai ma au
Asa tong tutu hatangku, unang be margabus au
Sasude na roa pe, tanggal sian au muse
Ho dipuji, o Tuhanku, hata dohot pambaenanku.
Tatap ma sude donganku, nasa bangso Batak i
Saluhutna sisolhothu nang so tinanda i
Taiti ma sudena i tu hataM na denggan i
Asa dohot i malua sian begu dohot dosa.
Rarat baen harajaonMu tu sandok portibi on
Sai pabinsar ma sondangMu tu sude di tano on
Nasa na ni linggom ni hamatean i dope
Togu ma tu hatorangan asa dapot hasonangan.

A-sa tong tu-tu ha-tang-ku, u-nang be mar-ga-bus au
Sa-su-de na ro-a pe, tang-gal si-an au mu-se Ho di-pu-ji, o Tu-han-ku, ha-ta do-hot pam-bae-nan-ku.
Ta-tap ma su-de do-ngan-ku, na-sa bang-so Ba-tak i
Sa-lu-hut-na si-sol-hot-hu nang so ti-nan-da i Ta
i-ti ma su-de-na i tu ha-taM na deng-gan i A-sa do-hot i ma-lu-a si-an be-gu do-hot do-sa.

Ai ma-si-boan do-sa-na be do ha-mi tu jo-lom.
A-si ro-haM di ha-mi be, sai se-sa do-sa i su-de, mar-hi-te Je-sus A-nak-Mi, na ma-te di hau si-lang i, Di Gol-ga-ta, Di do-dok Gol-ga-ta.

verses: Ale Jahowa Debata! Sai tatap hani on,
Ai masiboan dosana be do hami tu jolom.
Asi rohaM di hami be, sai sesa dosa i sude,
Marhite Jesus AnakMi, na mate di hau silang i,
Di Golgata, Di dodok Golgata.
O Jesus, haholongan i sai tatap haami on !
Ho Pangondingannami i, ondingi hami on,
Sai unang mago hami be, ai na tinobasMi sude.
Taluhon ma sibolis i, ai na jorbut parulan ni,
Pangolu be ma hami on sude.
Ho, Tondi Parbadia i ! Sai tatap hami on!
Lopokkon haholongonMi tu rohanami on !
Pasada rohanami be, patiur tondinami pe
Lao manghuthon dasdasMi, mangkasiholi sondang ni
Parholong i, pardenggan basa i.

r: O Je-sus, ha-ho-lo-ngan i sai ta-tap haa-mi on!
Ho Pa-ngon-di-ngan-na-mi i, on-di-ngi ha-mi on,
Sai u-nang ma-go ha-mi be, ai na ti-no-bas-Mi su-de. Ta-lu-hon ma si-bo-lis i, ai na jor-but pa-ru-lan ni, Pa-ngo-lu be ma ha-mi on su-de.
Ho, Ton-di Par-ba-di-a i! Sai ta-tap ha-mi on!
Lo-pok-kon ha-ho-lo-ngon-Mi tu ro-ha-na-mi on!
Pa-sa-da ro-ha-na-mi be, pa-ti-ur ton-di-na-mi pe La-o mang-hut-hon das-das-Mi, mang-ka-si-ho-li son-dang ni Par-ho-long i, par-deng-gan ba-sa i.

verses: Tuhan Debata, sai ramoti ma daging dahot tondinami,
I do pangidoannami. Sai pahipas be hami on sude!
Jesus Ho tutu, Raja na burju, sai palua tondinami
Sian pardosaonnami, pasupasu be hami on sude !
Sai parbadiai, sai tongtong rajai, ale Tondi Parbadia.
Rohanami asa ria, mangoloi hataM, hombar tu rohaM !

rows: Di-tom-pa Ho do au, son-da-ngi ro-hang-kon:
Tung ba-sa-ba-sa-Mi su-de na di au on.
Gom-go-mi pa-ma-tang-ku, naeng Ho do o-lo-an-ku,
Sai le-hon ma go-gong-ku, lo-moM naeng u-la-on-ku
U-ru-pi, ta-tap au tu-tu, Pa-nom-pa na bur-ju.

verses: Ditompa Ho do au, sondangi rohangkon:
Tung basabasaMi sude na di au on.
Gomgomi pamatangku, naeng Ho do oloanku,
Sai lehon ma gogongku, lomoM naeng ulaonku
Urupi, tatap au tutu, Panompa na burju.
Tuhan, Sihophop au, sai buri tondingkon.
Marhite mudarMi torusi ngolungkon.
Pinuji ma goarMu, arga ma pangkophopMu,
Dibaen pangalahongku, nang nasa ulaonku,
O Jesus, Sipalua au tu Ho ma au patau.
Tu TondiMi, Tuhan, hulehon diringkon.
Sai tong ma dirajai sandok pamatangkon.
Ibana hutangihon, sai saut au ditogihon
Tu ngolu partondion, manahan di ujian.
O Tondi Parbadia i, sai Ho ma rajangki,
Ale Debatangki, Sitolusada i
Bongoti rohangki, paarbadiai ma i.
Sai Ho ma lam hutanda, gogongku lam paganda.
Manangkup haluaon, maniop hatuaon
Ni Ama, Anak, Tondi i, na tong pujion i.

Di-baen pa-nga-la-hong-ku, nang na-sa u-la-on-ku,
O Je-sus, Si-pa-lu-a au tu Ho ma au pa-tau.
Tu Ton-di-Mi, Tu-han, hu-le-hon di-ring-kon.
Sai tong ma di-ra-jai san-dok pa-ma-tang-kon.
I-ba-na hu-ta-ngi-hon, sai saut au di-to-gi-hon
Tu ngo-lu par-ton-di-on, ma-na-han di u-ji-an.
O Ton-di Par-ba-di-a i, sai Ho ma ra-jang-ki,
A-le De-ba-tang-ki, Si-to-lu-sa-da i
Bo-ngo-ti ro-hang-ki, paar-ba-dia-i ma i.
Sai Ho ma lam hu-tan-da, go-gong-ku lam pa-gan-da.
Ma-nang-kup ha-lu-a-on, ma-ni-op ha-tu-a-on
Ni A-ma, A-nak, Ton-di i, na tong pu-ji-on i.

verses: Ale Immanuel, tatap ma hami, na tinobusmu, na pinaluaM;
Na sinosahan ni musu do hami. Ala tongtong nioloan hataM.
Gasa disuan mangalo Anakmu Jala na jahat do, ninna na burju
Nunga nania na burju najolo na marna loja na modom nuaeng;
Ai diparbaga rohana, ndang olo talu nasida, hape sai dibaen
Musu bisukna manjail nang nasida, jadi burjuna adang be na tarida.
Lam tu ngalina do holong ni roha, lam tu hijangna do naposo i;
Mansai torop do na lao tu na roa na lilianan dibaen setan i,
Marsak do roha ni nasa na burju mida na lusam na di huriaMu.
Ipe, o Jesus sai tatap ma hami jala sungguli ma dongan sude;
Unang ma modom di dosa be hami, burju marroha baen hami muse.
Asa tarsunggul sude huriaMu jala rap hehe pasauthon hataMu.
Tatap o Jesus, sudo di balian angka parbegu, na lilu dope,
Angka na hundul di na nilinggoman ni hmatean, sai jou ma sude,
Asa malua nang i musengani, dalan tu surgo muse didalani.
Sai harnonangkon sude hajolmaon, taiti sandok manisia tu Ho;
Asa diboan sude hasangapon dohot pelean na hushus di Ho,
Jala dipuji sude manisia, Ho, ale Tuhan, na tong marmulia.

su bi-suk-na man-jail nang na-si-da, ja-di bur-ju-na a-dang be na ta-ri-da.

A-sa tar-sung-gul su-de hu-ria-Mu ja-la rap he-he pa-sa-ut-hon ha-ta-Mu.
